contracts.name: Julio Rodríguez
contracts.desc: 12 yr, $209.3M (2023-34), 2030-34 player options; conditional club options after 2029 (8 or 10 years)
contracts.note: Rodríguez's club option, decided upon after 2028, is based on MVP vote finishes from 2022-2028. As of the end of the 2025 season, Rodríguez has been in the top ten of voting three times, which currently makes his club option eight years and $240 million. With one further top-ten finish, the club option would increase to eight years and $260 million. With one MVP award or two more top-five finishes joining his top-five finish in 2023, the option would be eight years and $280 million. If he wins two MVPs or is in the top five three further times, the option would be 10 years for $350 million. If the option is declined, there is a mutual option for seven years and $168 million decided upon at the end of the 2029 season.

contracts.note:
$10M each from 2031 and 2033 is deferred, each paid in five installments of $2M each. The 2031 deferrals are paid from 2035-2039, and the 2032 deferrals from 2040-2044.

Sánchez's prior 4 yr, $22.5M extension, covering 2025-28 (with club options for 2029-30), is partially overwritten by the new extension beginning in 2027. Under his old extension, Sánchez's AAV was $5.625M, and remains such for 2025-26, even though Sánchez will only earn $6.5M ($3.25M AAV) over the two years of his extension. Because the Phillies are overcharged by $4.75M when comparing to what Sánchez actually earns, that difference is credited to the life of his new contract, further lowering its AAV.
